assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness that are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard ambulatory monitoring.
Given the history of supraventricular tachycardia and ongoing dizziness, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to provide continuous rhythm correlation with symptoms over an extended period.
The service addresses the specific clinical need for CPT 93229.
The diagnosis codes are I47.1 and R42.
